Wednesday 14 October 2026 · 26 stories
Morning Brief
Nifty 50 rose 1.60% to 22,722 on narrow participation
Today’s read
The biggest names carried the session. The fifty most traded stocks returned +3.29% weighted by turnover, against +0.30% for the median stock, a gap of 3.0 percentage points, so most stocks did worse than the busiest names suggest.

Media Matrix Worldwide Limited rose 0.4% on 164 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Global Market: IMF urges governments to cut spending, reduce debt as borrowing costs rise”.

Uday Jewellery Industries Limited rose 5.4% on 164 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Jewellery stocks ahead of festive season: Can Q2 deliver sustained growth amid rising rates, bond yields?”.

Shringar House of Mangalsutra Limited rose 17.1% on 165 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Urban Company jumps 3% on fundraising plans; JM Fin calls the step prudent”.

Nothing in the news or in exchange filings explains the volume in Pix Transmissions Limited (141x), Amal Limited (119x), Indokem Limited (88x). That usually points to a sector story rather than a company one.

India's inflation hits 5.54%: Onion prices up 108%, food inflation 7.74% | 10 numbers explained
India's retail inflation climbed to 5.54%, driven by a 7.74% surge in food inflation and a 108% spike in onion prices. Stickier food prices delay Reserve Bank of India interest rate cuts, keeping borrowing costs elevated for capital-intensive sectors while dampening volume growth for consumer staple companies. The arrival pace of winter crops over the coming weeks will confirm if this spike is transitory.

The claim exceeds the bank's net worth, but courts rarely entertain speculative damages from defaulting borrowers facing ongoing recovery proceedings. A court decision on whether to admit the petition will confirm if this poses any genuine financial risk.
